selfReview.method: Translated each distinct Japanese paragraph into an exact source-keyed own Khmer map. Reviewed contextual use before expanding repeated full glossary/prose strings. Read new Khmer as connected explanations and dialogue while comparing all Japanese paragraph/question/option/rationale meanings, then verified complete assembled source bindings after the last terminology pass.
semanticChecks: Emotion, motivation and stress stay distinct. Memory encoding/retention/recall and episodic/semantic/procedural memory remain separate; priming does not imply conscious recall. Brain-function examples do not become individual diagnoses.

Homeostasis means maintenance within a range rather than no change. Vital signs retain measurement conditions, time, units and personal baseline; unmeasured and unasked never become normal or no symptom. Cough, sputum, choking and vomiting stay distinct, including silent aspiration uncertainty.

Age does not determine ability, hearing or wishes. Dehydration, edema, fever, itch, constipation and insomnia remain distinct. Severe changes and symptom observations retain explicit medical-professional recipients. Fluid/salt/medication/activity changes remain bound to individual plans and medical instructions.

ICF includes environment and participation, not only impairment. Language functions and communication methods remain individually checked. Visual/hearing impairment does not imply impaired understanding; orientation-specific right/left and permission before touch remain explicit.

Dementia is confirmed only within the stated practice scenario, never inferred from a single forgotten event or extended to other scenarios. Core vs behavioral/psychological symptoms, causes and overlap remain distinct. Receiving anxiety does not confirm the unverified appointment or theft.

Internal impairments and oxygen/dialysis/pacemaker/stoma supports keep different purposes, scope, training, instructions and individual plans. Device operation is separate from the person’s comfort; no independent setting changes or untrained procedures are authorized.

Water-at11:10 report retains source uncertainty and distinction between no injury report and all people confirmed uninjured. Cleaning notification does not equal verified floor/pass conditions or authorize reopening.

Worker-health reports distinguish worker fatigue/pain from recipient condition, unstarted assistance, safe supervision by assigned staff, pending reassignment and unconfirmed cause. Learning body mechanics or possessing equipment does not authorize solo/manual lifting or untrained operation.

Supplemental staged dialogue preserves08:20 vs separate09:15 and09:20 practice records; pain was unasked at09:15 and denied by the person only at09:20. Nurse notified vs arrived/assessed, unknown measurements/cause and pending worker reassignment stay distinct. Emergency help is not delayed to finish questioning or documentation.
All70questions retain four complete source-specific rationales and unchanged answer positions. No rationale was replaced by a generic correct/incorrect label.
styleChecks: Neutral ខ្ញុំ/អ្នក, stated preferred names and explicit roles preserve respectful adult speech without invented gender, age, kinship or social titles.
Complete connected Khmer sentences preserve causes, contrast, uncertainty and sequence rather than reducing clinical prose to notes.

All identical Japanese glossary strings reuse exact own Khmer wording across expanded week02 records and checked week01 glossary where source strings match. Educational Japanese headword/kana are retained only in glossary entries.
Titles, lesson objectives, contexts and art captions match the same register; illustrations are not treated as diagnostic evidence or technical procedure instructions.
